about: The library's golden vectors. 'hand' cases are worked by hand on a few bars. 'bars' is the fixed 1,000-bar 15-minute set, in paise, with a flat stretch at bars 300 to 324. 'cases' pin the arrays of the pinned openalgo.ta at the 'sample' bar indices (null is NaN); 'first' is the first bar with a value. 'rolling' pins the rolling maximum and minimum of the closes. mfi, cci, vwma, cmf and rvol are the screener's own sums (library.py says why), the rest are the library's. Made by tests/make_library_vectors.py.

hand.note: ema(2) of 10, 20, 30 starts at the first value: alpha 2/3; the screener calls ema(5) ready only at 15 bars
hand.name: ema

hand.note: rsi(2) of 10, 11, 10, 12, 13: Wilder smoothing from a simple average
hand.name: rsi

hand.note: atr(2): the first bar's true range is high minus low, Wilder after
hand.name: atr

hand.note: tema(2) of 10 to 50: each average starts from the first value of its input and drops its first result; exact fractions 9910/243 and 36730/729
hand.name: tema

hand.note: mfi(2) on typical price 10, 12, 11, 11, 11, 13 with volume 100 to 600: rises 2400 (bar 1) and 7800 (bar 5), fall 3300 (bar 2); 42.105263 = 100*2400/5700; a window that never moved has no index
hand.name: mfi

hand.note: cmf(2): multipliers +1, -1, 0, +1, +1 on volume 100, 300, 200, 0, 0; -200/400, -300/500, 0/200; a window without volume has none
hand.name: cmf

hand.note: rvol(2) of volume 10, 30, 0, 0: 30/20, 0/15, then no average
hand.name: rvol

hand.note: vwma(3): (100*10 + 102*20 + 0)/30, then 102 alone, then no volume
hand.name: vwma

hand.note: cci(3) of identical bars whose typical price (31/3) is not a whole number: no deviation, 0
hand.name: cci
